_header: PLANTED SYNTHETIC — POSITIVE CONTROL — NOT A MEASUREMENT OF VLD VALUE ON REAL DECISIONS.
_stage: Stage 1: 40 template instances + 10 controls = 50 SOC instances
_deviations_from_prompt: rho=0.50 conflict: the per-template v5 rule (4 instances) contradicts the distribution table ('exactly 5'). Kept the distribution table; v5 for score_keyed templates is the rho=0.30 confidently-wrong case instead, which exercises the O-3 fallback detector.
Check 8 ('all 5 variations reach DIFFERENT leaf actions') is unsatisfiable with 4 SOC actions; read as '>=4 distinct actions across the 5 variations', which every template meets.
Check 5 (>=2 distinct actions in alternative_branches) is validated over non-flat instances only; flat controls have no branches by construction.

SOC-MH-002 v1/v2 share the terminal action 'escalate' but differ in ground_truth_route (hr_led vs security_led). The evaluator must score route, not action alone, or VLD will be marked wrong when it was right.
_single_pass_fields: Absent by design (spec 1.1). single_pass_action / single_pass_correct / why_single_pass_fails are produced by the scoring pass, not authored here.
